messages:
Marie (AE): hi team — forwarding bernard's follow up from yesterday, they're asking if we can do a 2-week air-gapped POC with delta patching and signed bundles
Devin (SalesSE): thanks, marie. primary Qs I heard: how we deliver bundle (signed), how upgrades work offline, and pricing for short POC.
Bernard (Customer IT): correct — we need to confirm patch cadence, SBOM availability, and whether we support staged rollbacks without internet access.
Sanjay (Eng): we support signed tarball bundles + detached signature. For air-gap POC we usually provide a full bundle + deltas for subsequent patches.
Olivia (Security): we'll need an SBOM (SPDX) for each bundle and a verification checklist. also confirm the bundle signing algorithm (RSA4096 or ECDSA).
Sanjay (Eng): current tooling signs with ECDSA-P256 by default; we can produce RSA4096 on request. SBOM generation is automatic at build time.
Devin (SalesSE): bernard — does your security team require a specific signature alg or just FIPS-validated crypto?
Bernard (Customer IT): FIPS validation is a hard requirement. also HSM integration for key custody would be preferred but if you manage signing we need attestations.
Olivia (Security): we can offer a dev-time signed bundle + a customer-managed signing flow for production. For POC we can run with redwood-signed artifacts and provide HSM integration guidance for later.
Marie (AE): pricing — for a 2-week POC we usually do a time-limited license and a one-off airgap packaging fee. bernard, what's your procurement timeline?
Bernard (Customer IT): procurement can sign a simple SOW in 1 week. POC schedule target: start onboarding 2 weeks from SOW.
Sanjay (Eng): operational constraints: bundle size depends on quantization. We can produce a 'minibundle' with model weights quantized to int8 to cut size ~3-4x. That speeds transfers and reduces install time.
Devin (SalesSE): good to know. bernard — will you accept a minibundle for the POC, or do you need full-precision?
Bernard (Customer IT): minibundle is fine for evaluation, but we need to validate quality delta with a sample prompts set.
Sanjay (Eng): we can include a small eval harness and tokenized sample set. Also: upgrade cadence — for POC we'd push at most one delta patch. For production, we recommend monthly or biweekly deltas depending on critical fixes.
Olivia (Security): also note cert rotation. In an air-gapped environment you must rotate node certs locally. We'll provide a rotation tool that runs offline with a signed CSR flow.
Sanjay (Eng): yes — we ship a rotation CLI. It accepts locally injected root CA and reissues node certs. No outbound required.
Bernard (Customer IT): great. what's the rollback story if an upgrade fails?
Sanjay (Eng): bundles are atomic: we snapshot config and KV cache pointers. Upgrade script can roll back to previous bundle within the same offline host. We'll provide step-by-step runbook.
Devin (SalesSE): deployment logistics: do you want us to ship an encrypted USB or provide a secure S3 export for your transfer process?
Bernard (Customer IT): encrypted USB is our preferred method for air-gapped labs. must be pre-signed and checksummed.
Marie (AE): action items: 1) SRE to produce a minibundle signed with RSA4096 (per bernard) + SPDX SBOM; 2) security to prepare HSM integration doc and attestations; 3) sales to draft POC SOW + pricing (airgap packaging fee + 2-week license).
Sanjay (Eng): I'll start the minibundle build and include the eval harness. ETA 4 business days.
Olivia (Security): I'll assemble the SBOM and HSM guidance doc, and list FIPS controls we meet. ETA 3 business days.
Devin (SalesSE): I'll draft SOW and provisional pricing — include a one-time packaging fee and a refundable deposit for the USB shipping. ETA 1 business day.
Bernard (Customer IT): perfect. can we also get a short checklist for firewall rules if we later sync updates via a jump host?
Sanjay (Eng): yes — we'll provide an optional jump-host sync playbook that uses signed deltas over scp. That will be a separate deliverable.
Marie (AE): thanks everyone. bernard — I'll schedule a 30m kickoff next Wednesday to lock dates. any blockers we should know about?
Bernard (Customer IT): nothing immediate. just need the RSA-signed minibundle and SBOM to pass internal review.
DeployBot: bundle build started for job id bld-7621 (ETA ~3h) :gear:
Sanjay (Eng): noted, following up in build channel and will post checksums once done.
Devin (SalesSE): great — I'll attach the draft SOW to this thread when ready. :thumbsup:
Marie (AE): end of thread for now — will update after docs are posted.
